text:
sam_support: FYI -> CS handoff for Skyport Labs trial. Onboarding pipeline unstable after a model/quant bucket promotion; embeddings skewed (~17% similarity drop) and bulk ingest returning intermittent 429/timeout. Activation fell to 27%. Sales touch in 6 days — need CS bridge + short customer note ASAP.

harper_se: Reproduced on tenant. Canary promotion pushed a new int8 quant bucket that changes tokenization edge cases for long docs; also the worker queue gets hot and surfaces 429s. I've applied a tenant-scoped circuit (throttle) to keep them from failing and queued a rollback to the previous quant bucket. Internal ref: IR-12177.

jo_csm: I'll own the customer comms and bridge. Can someone paste a one-paragraph, non-tech blurb I can send now? Scheduling 30m bridge at 11am PT. @marta_csm_lead FYI — if activation doesn't recover above 30% after 24h, escalate renewal ops.

marta_csm_lead: Got it. Prep renewal mitigation options: (1) 7-day trial extension, (2) account credit pro-rated, (3) prioritized enablement + audit export. Jo, capture customer sentiment and ask if they'd like a pre/post embeddings export.

harper_se: Customer-facing blurb: "We're reverting a recent quantization change that affected document similarity for your tenant and applied a temporary stabilization. We expect measurable improvements within ~45 minutes and will review live on the bridge."

sam_support: Pushed a minimal log excerpt: `ingest::429 "worker_queue_full" at 2026-07-05T10:12:03Z`; `embed_sim baseline 0.89 -> 0.74 after quant-promo`. Also linked a tiny repro script in the internal ticket.

pager_bot: Incident IR-12177 created and escalated to CS. Priority: P2. Bridge scheduled: 2026-07-05T11:00:00-07:00. Eng oncall paged.

jo_csm: Thanks. Comms plan (owners): 1) Immediate customer ping = Jo, 2) Bridge + tech RCA = Harper + Sam, 3) Postmortem & credits = Marta. If we need exec outreach, I'll loop in Sales Ops after the bridge.

harper_se: Rollback runbook snippet for on-call: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal/api/admin/tenants/rollback -d '{"tenant":"skyport","target":"quant-v1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

sam_support: Invite sent to customer + CS owners. I'll join the bridge and stream logs. Sync 10m before.

jo_csm: I'll send the short note now and attach a 2-question pulse survey post-call: https://redwood.feedback/s/skyport-onboard (Q1 friction, Q2 ask for export). If activation remains <30% in 24h, Marta will approve credits. :white_check_mark:
